goal: With its opt-in triage trust rule enabled, the github work source schedules a ready-labeled issue only when its spec block carries a triage receipt matching the issue's current human content, and skips every other ready issue loudly without falling back to defaults graders.

relevant: packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_github.py -- the source gaining the trust rule
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_triage_receipt.py -- NEW shared module: receipt schema and content-hash definition
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/tests/test_github_source.py -- keep green; mirror its _FakeGh scripted-runner pattern
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/tests/test_github_drain_trust.py -- NEW test file for the trust behavior
references: docs/work-sources.md -- the github source contract (present-but-invalid block raises; zero graders skips)
constraints: The receipt schema (command, exit_code, base_sha, content_hash) and the content-hash definition (issue title + body with the ```flywheel block stripped) live only in the new _triage_receipt.py module; the triage engine imports it later -- do not duplicate either definition inside _github.py
The trust rule is an opt-in [source] key require_triage_receipt (default false); with it false or absent, source behavior is byte-identical to today

With the rule enabled: valid block + receipt matching current content hash yields a WorkItem; missing block, missing receipt, or hash mismatch yields no WorkItem plus one surfaced skip line through the existing log seam, even when [[defaults.graders]] is configured
A DONE WorkReport under done_action=close must close the issue with the grader-receipt body (pin this end-to-end in the new test file alongside the trust rule)
Commit the change with a Conventional Commit message before reporting done
non_goals: Do not modify existing test files; do not weaken or delete assertions
Do not touch _github_ci.py, _github_review.py, or the directory source
No triage engine, no CLI verb, no [triage] policy table -- this task is drain-side only
Do not change present-but-invalid spec-block semantics (it still raises WorkSourceError)
Do not read or write under .flywheel/verification/
edge_cases: Ready label with no spec block: skipped and surfaced even with [[defaults.graders]] configured -- the fallback must not fire in trust mode
Ready label, valid block, receipt hash stale after a body edit: no WorkItem
A receipt whose fields parse but whose exit_code is 0 is not a valid fail-first receipt
Trust rule off: an issue with no block still falls back to defaults graders exactly as today
